sentences.text: HONOURABLE MS. JUSTICE NISHA M. THAKORE
Heard Mr. Mehul Sharad Shah, learned advocate for the applicant- original claimant.

Learned advocate Mr. Mandeep Saluja has received instructions to appear on behalf of respondent no.2- Insurance Company and Mr. Manohar Rahevar, learned Assistant Government Pleader has appeared on behalf of respondent State Authority on advance copy.

With the consent of the learned advocates for the respective parties, in absence of any objection being raised with regard to prayer sought for in the present application, the same is taken up for hearing at the admission stage.
2. Present application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act read with Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act praying for condonation of delay of 138 days caused in preferring the appeal.

3. Learned advocate for the applicant- original claimant NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/4687/2025 ORDER DATED: 08/09/2025 undefined has mainly relied upon the relevant dates referred to in para 4 of the application and has urged this Court that because of the circumstances narrated in the para 4, the appeal could not be presented within the prescribed period of limitation.

He has further urged that looking to the benevolent piece of legislation, the applicant intends to present his case for Madhuben @ Madhukantaben Bipinbhai ... vs Deputy Executive Engineer on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55793326/
1 enhancement of the compensation.

entities.text: Madhuben @ Madhukantaben Bipinbhai ... vs Deputy Executive Engineer on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He has therefore, urged this Court to take liberal view and condone the delay.

4. Considering the submissions made by the learned advocate for the applicant, in light of the averments made in the application being deposed on oath, considering the number of days involved and in absence of any objection being raised by the respondents, the present application seeking condonation of delay of 138 day caused in preferring the appeal is hereby condoned.
5. Learned advocate Mr. Saluja is permitted to file Vakalatnama on behalf of respondent no.2- Insurance Company within a period of three days from today.
Registry is directed to accept the same.
Registry is directed to reflect the name of respective learned advocates for the respondents in the main appeal.

(NISHA M. THAKORE,J) RATHOD KAUSHIKSINH Madhuben @ Madhukantaben Bipinbhai ... vs Deputy Executive Engineer on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55793326/
